projects.name: AI / RAG / KNOWLEDGE GRAPH PROJECT
projects.description: Developed an agentic AI RAG system for Honda Aircraft requirements-to-test-case traceability, processing requirements and test-case documents through specialized agents for document parsing, requirement extraction, structuring, semantic retrieval, and traceability mapping. Implemented a multi-agent document-processing workflow using Python, LangChain, LangGraph, Ollama, Qdrant, embeddings, and prompt-driven structured extraction to connect requirements with relevant test cases. Architected the system to process PDF documents containing text, tables, and structured test procedures while retaining document metadata, chunk lineage, and source context for traceability. Built semantic retrieval and mapping workflows that identify relationships between requirements and test cases and generate mapping rationale grounded in source documentation. Worked on a knowledge-graph-based traceability approach to represent relationships among requirements, test cases, documents, components, and verification evidence for explainable engineering analysis. Containerized RAG and AI services with Docker and integrated local LLM inference through Ollama to support an offline engineering knowledge environment without cloud inference dependencies. Created multiple specialized agents for document processing, requirement extraction, requirement structuring, retrieval, and requirement-to-test-case mapping, improving separation of concerns and explainability. Established vector indexing with Qdrant and embedding-based retrieval for engineering documentation, preserving document-level metadata for downstream traceability. Applied chunking, metadata lineage, context preservation, and validation controls to reduce hallucinated requirement identifiers and keep traceability mappings grounded in source documents.
